premises.text: Clients expect personalized portfolios and individualized advice, but advisors lack time/tools and dump clients into generic mutual funds and ETFs while relationships remain their strength
premises.evidence_span: Clients expect personalized portfolios tailored to their needs, but instead are getting dumped into generic buckets of mutual funds and ETFs

premises.text: AI builds personalized portfolios of stocks/bonds/assets around client goals, risk, constraints, and firm or client strategies, and automates ongoing management and rebalancing
premises.evidence_span: VizEye is an artificial intelligence platform tailored to investment advisors so they can automate portfolio construction and management

premises.text: Portfolio intelligence / NLG explains the why behind holdings so advisors can tell clients a clear story
premises.evidence_span: We then provide the portfolio intelligence for them to be able to explain those investment decisions and the why behind their portfolio to the clients

premises.text: Low AUM fee (~20 bps) sold direct to advisors, with distribution via large financial institutions and Riskalyze
premises.evidence_span: We charge a low AUM fee of 20 basis points, selling direct to investment advisors

domains.name: Generic portfolios vs personalized advice gap

value.text: Advisors deliver personalized portfolios and clearer client stories while focusing time on trusted relationships
value.evidence_span: advisors can focus their time on what they do best, building great client relationships
